import re

pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()

print(login_resp)

query = 'Woodstock Reimagined: Festival Vibes'

    resp = apis.spotify.search_playlists(query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, access_token=access_token)

        break
    all_playlists.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('Total search results:', len(all_playlists))
